task.ques: Choose one way business class ticket from Hong Kong to Glacier National Park on 6 July 2027, offering a 1 stop ticket.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Choose Cathay Pacific + Alaska, one way from Hong Kong (HKG) to Glacier Park International Airport (FCA), serving Glacier National Park, on 6 July 2027, with 1 stop in Seattle (SEA).

Depart HKG at 1:25 PM on Cathay Pacific CX 852 in Business Class; arrive SEA at 10:20 AM. After a 2 hr 56 min layover, take Alaska AS 2072, operated by Horizon Air as Alaska Horizon, at 1:16 PM in First Class; arrive FCA at 3:35 PM the same day. Total journey: 16 hr 10 min. Times are local.

Google Flights lists this itinerary under its Business search as “Business Class + First Class.” Search-result fare: RSD 604,688 for 1 adult. The selected itinerary's Cathay Pacific booking option showed RSD 604,337 (HK$44,912). No purchase was made.

Evidence: final.png shows the Google Flights search with One way, Business, Tue Jul 6, the 1 stop or fewer filter, and the Cathay Pacific + Alaska itinerary. The departure year was confirmed in the date picker as Tuesday, July 6, 2027 and in the selected itinerary search date (2027-07-06).
Source: https://www.google.com/travel/flights/search?tfs=CBwQAhogEgoyMDI3LTA3LTA2KAFqBwgBEgNIS0dyBwgBEgNGQ0FAAUgDcAGCAQsI____________AZgBAg&tfu=EgYIABAAGAA
